This font is redistributed under the SIL OFL 1.1. It is a test fixture: a
small (~28 KB), single-script TrueType font whose glyphs sit entirely outside
the WinAnsi range, used to exercise VibePDF's font-embedding path
(P4.HF5 / FABLE_REVIEW 3.2 stage-2). It is not shipped in the application.
